title: Druvis Ⅲ
subtitle: She stood here. She was not waiting for anyone, nor was she trying to remember anyone.

trails.title: Trail ① Incantation Upgrade
trails.description:
A record on how to make incantations more threatening.
Merging incantations will improve their power and even change their effects.

trails.title: Incredible Unicorn
trails.description: Sotheby's mansion has thousands of artifacts. What is the thing with one horn hung high above her hall that always gazes at people?

items.text: Druvis Ⅲ

items.speaker: Critters
items.text: *appear*

items.speaker: Critters
items.text: Sss!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, too many of them. We can only take one round at most, not for long.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Critters keep coming from the roots. Are they living here?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Coming again. Careful!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *coughing*

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, did you see my mark on the map?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: According to my calculation, that's the closest position to the edge of the woods.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: In one minute, I'll cover you to move in the opposite direction! Remember, there's a slope two miles away that can slow down the critters.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Sonetto, aren't you coming with us?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Suppressed by such an overwhelming number, we can't get out!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry. The action strategy would be more flexible if there's only me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As long as the enemies are not ghosts ... no, even if they are ghosts, I will survive.
I trust you.

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: Please trust me. Just like ... how we used to be.

items.text: Where do we meet then?

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: I will always find you. Please retreat quickly.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let's go, Mr. APPLe.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: May the peace be with us.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: They are all coming for us!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... It's a good thing.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Maybe we covered Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: As long as one of us can leave the woods, there's hope for the rest.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Too late to climb up the slope. Get ready to fight!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mr. APPLe, how much longer can you hold on?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Though it may not sound like what an apple should say ... this APPLe will fight with you to the last moment!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Vertin, look out!
Hmm?
No offense.
Would you please pass me my heel?
It seems to have fallen into your arms.
... Who are you?

branch.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
branch.text: I am Druvis III, the owner of the woods.

items.text: ... Why are you in such a high place?

branch.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
branch.text: I am Druvis III. It's my pleasure to meet you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... The heels ... here you are.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Thank you. Then I will come down and clean up the mess.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: It's fine to land barefoot. However ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I don't like touching them directly ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... These invaders.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: She beats hundreds of them with one single move?! Is it the power of her wand ...?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: No, the arcane circle she cast is pretty archaic. She must have a European arcanum background.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: It has been a long time since I saw the arcanist visitors.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Thank you for helping me expel the critters. Then, as for the ones left ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Just as the woods prophesy in whisper—invaders, you shall offer your sacrifice for the peace.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Please allow us to assist you!
TO BE CONTINUED…
